requirements.summary: Model Prompt CN/EN remains a generation-plane projection of locked Art Direction rather than a short creative recap.
A short product/background/camera/light summary cannot masquerade as a complete acting Prompt when locked geometry, material, culture, inclusion or evidence decisions remain unconsumed.

Concrete selected values across static geometry/material/culture/inclusion/copy, dynamic motion/timing/audio, and scene-derived camera/lighting/CMF are consumed by the acting Prompt and auditable as concrete continuity.

Commercial-grade Prompt density consumes route-relevant pixel/frame/audio-changing Art Direction decisions without generic-adjective collapse, cross-language typography leakage or governance metadata leakage.
